title: Built for every role on the sustainability team.
intro: From carbon accountants chasing emission factors to auditors verifying disclosures — Nexus gives each role exactly the surface they need, with the data linked underneath.

carbon.blurb: Get every emission factor, every conversion, every Scope 3 category right — and audit-traced.

calculators.title: GHG Protocol calculators
calculators.body: 10+ modules covering Scope 1, 2, and all 15 Scope 3 categories.

efLibrary.title: EF library with versioning
efLibrary.body: DEFRA, EPA, IPCC, plus custom factors. Older reports stay locked to their original factors.

bulkEntry.title: Excel-style bulk entry
bulkEntry.body: Paste from your existing spreadsheet; we map columns and validate units.

esg.blurb: Coordinate dozens of contributors across frameworks without ever leaving the platform.

assignments.title: Assignments + reminders
assignments.body: Assign disclosures to subsidiaries, set deadlines, escalate when they slip.

narrative.title: AI narrative drafts
narrative.body: Claude drafts disclosure prose from your actual data, ready for human edit.

mapping.title: Cross-framework mapping
mapping.body: One GRI disclosure can answer ESRS, ISSB, and SEC questions — automatically.

auditors.blurb: Read-only access with full lineage on every number. No screenshare marathons.

blockchain.title: Blockchain proof per disclosure
blockchain.body: Every published number is hashed and anchored. Tamper-evident on demand.

custody.title: Evidence chain of custody
custody.body: Click any figure → see the source PDF, the contributor, the approver, the timestamps.

auditRole.title: Audit-only role
auditRole.body: Granular RBAC — auditors see published data, never drafts or in-flight values.

plant.blurb: Answer assigned questions in 5 minutes a month, not 5 hours.

tasks.title: Plant-scoped tasks
tasks.body: Only see what you own. No 200-question questionnaires.

connectors.title: Connector ingestion
connectors.body: Pull from SAP, Sage, AWS, Azure billing, energy meters — set it once and forget.

anomaly.title: Anomaly detection
anomaly.body: AI flags unusual values before they reach the group rollup.

compliance.title: SOC 2 + GDPR
compliance.body: SOC 2 Type II in progress. ISO 27001 mapping. Full DPA + subprocessor list.

residency.title: Multi-region residency
residency.body: EU (Frankfurt) and US (Virginia). Self-hosted Terraform module available.

approvals.title: Approvals chain
approvals.body: Configurable review/approval workflow with delegated permissions.

aiSafety.title: AI safety layer
aiSafety.body: No customer data leaves your tenant to train models. Every AI output is human-reviewed.

cta.heading: See it on your own data.
